title: I Tried 100+ Claude Code Skills. These 6 I Can’t Live Without
content: This video details three essential plugins for the ClaudeCode AI development environment: 'Skill Creator' which automates skill generation from natural language, 'Superpowers' which enforces a structured development workflow improving code quality, and 'GSD' (Get S*** Done) which combats context degradation by spawning fresh sub-agents. These plugins provide practical solutions that offer business value, such as saving time, money, and reducing errors in the AI development process.

visual_intelligence.reason: Provides critical identification of the software platform, version, and underlying AI model.
visual_intelligence.context: A command-line interface is shown with the title 'Claude Code 2.1.86'. It lists the model as 'Sonnet 4.5' and shows available commands like `/agents to create subagents` and `/security-review`.

backlinks: AI Model: Anthropic's Claude (specifically Sonnet 4.5 mentioned in visuals)
Plugin 1: 'Skill Creator' (official from Anthropic), installed with `/plugin install skill creator`. Automates `skill.md5` file creation.
Plugin 2: 'Superpowers' (community plugin), enforces planning, isolated environments, TDD, and two-stage reviews.
Plugin 3: 'GSD' (Get S*** Done), uses context engineering by spawning sub-agents to prevent context rot. Features include quality gates: 'Scope production detection' and 'Security enforcement'.
